newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Pakland Cement up 11.67 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Pakland Cement up 11.67 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Pakland Cement jumped 1.75 rupees, or 11.67 percent, to 16.75 on hopes that the caretaker government would announce a relief package for the cement sector, dealers said.
A turnover of 97,500 shares of the stock had been recorded at the Karachi bourse by midsession.

"The government has already announced a relief package for the ailing textile sector and incentives for the stock market. Now people expect a similar package for the cement sector," dealer Shakil Anwar of Amanullah Suleman Securities said.
